raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the three categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with labeled intervals at 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, and 62. Each category contains five grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the methods, with distinct patterns and colors as indicated in the legend. The bars are arranged in a consistent order across the categories, with the methods ordered as DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (hatched orange), DAPO (diagonal striped light blue), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (cross-hatched green). The accuracy values for each method vary across the categories, with the highest accuracy observed in the Physics category for DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO, and the lowest in the Mathverse category for DAPO+Self-reflection and DAPO. The chart uses a linear scale for the vertical axis and presents the data in a grouped bar format without additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of five different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO—across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the three categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with a scale interval of 2%. Each category contains five grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the methods, distinguished by unique colors and patterns: blue with solid fill for DAPO+Self-reflection, orange with diagonal hatching for GRPO, light blue with diagonal stripes for DAPO, orange with solid fill for SRPO, and green with cross-hatching for PPO. The bars are grouped by category, with the methods appearing in the same order within each group. In Mathverse, the accuracy values range from approximately 53% (DAPO) to 56% (DAPO+Self-reflection). In MMLU, the values range from about 54% (PPO) to 57% (DAPO+Self-reflection). In Physics, the accuracy values range from approximately 56% (PPO) to 61% (DAPO+Self-reflection). The tallest bar in the chart is DAPO+Self-reflection in the Physics category, reaching approximately 61%, while the shortest bar is DAPO in the Mathverse category, at around 53%. The chart does not visually emphasize any specific bars through additional styling such as shadows or outlines.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of four different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PP0+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with tick marks at intervals of 2%. Each category contains five grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the models, with distinct colors and patterns: blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, light orange with diagonal stripes for GRPO, light blue with diagonal stripes for DAPO, dark green for PP0+Self-reflection, and light green with diagonal stripes for SRPO. In Mathverse, the accuracy values are approximately 53.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 54.2% for GRPO, 53.5% for DAPO, 54.8% for PP0+Self-reflection, and 53.5% for SRPO. In MMLU, the values are approximately 57.2% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 55.8% for GRPO, 56.0% for DAPO, 56.5% for PP0+Self-reflection, and 54.5% for SRPO. In Physics, the values are approximately 61.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58.5% for GRPO, 57.5% for DAPO, 59.5% for PP0+Self-reflection, and 60.5% for SRPO. The bars are grouped by category, and within each group, the models are ordered consistently from left to right as DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PP0+Self-reflection, and SRPO. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations.
